$Comment: The Gravekeeper's nights: live while Hallow's Eve runs or the Restless Moon is up (a full moon
outside Hallow's Eve, Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Moon.json). The file name is the event id. It is a
condition, not a run, so it has no dates, attendance, Almanac page or banner; Hallow's Eve and the
Restless Moon carry their own banners.
It is the Season of the Gravekeeper's one placement (NpcPlacements/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Temple.json),
so he stands at his Temple spot on both kinds of night and is gone otherwise. When Hallow's Eve starts
on a full moon the event stays live and he stays put; his conversation
(Dialogues/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper.json) shows each night's lines while that night is
live. Switching Hallow's Eve or the full moon off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json takes that
kind of night away from him; /zigcalendar status Seasons_Of_Orbis_Gravekeeper_Nights shows what the
